value.body: Bachelor of Homoeopathic Medicine and Surgery. You study anatomy, physiology, pathology and other medical subjects alongside homoeopathic materia medica, repertory and the Organon of Medicine, then complete a one-year internship. It is regulated by the National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH).

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, and a qualifying NEET-UG score. AACCC (Ministry of Ayush) counsels the 15% All India Quota and central, national-institute and deemed-university seats; states fill the rest through their own counselling.

value.title: At a glance
items: Practice needs registration with a State Board or Council of Homoeopathy.
Enrolment held steady at about 64,000–66,000 across 2021-22 to 2023-24.
An MD (Homoeopathy) through AIAPGET is the usual way to specialise.
